title: TaskContract
description: Standard task assignment contract issued by the Orchestrator to any agent in the Finance X platform.

parent_task_id.description: Parent task ID if this is a subtask. Null for top-level tasks.

analysis_session_id.description: Groups all tasks belonging to a single end-to-end analysis run.

assigned_agent.description: agent_id of the agent this task is assigned to.

requesting_agent.description: agent_id of the agent issuing this task (usually 'orchestrator' or 'ceo').

company_ticker.description: Primary BIST ticker symbol for this task. E.g. 'ASELS'.

company_name.description: Full company name. E.g. 'ASELSAN Elektronik Sanayi ve Ticaret A.Ş.'.

inputs.description: Task-type-specific inputs. Schema varies by task_type.

context.description: Contextual data passed to aid the assigned agent.

prior_outputs.description: Output IDs of previously completed tasks in this session.

runtime_context.description: Any runtime flags or session-level settings.

runtime_mode.description: Controls evidence depth, review cycles, and acceptable degradation.

min_confidence_level.description: Minimum acceptable overall confidence. Outputs below this must be flagged.

evidence_required.description: Whether at least one evidence reference is mandatory for every claim.

review_required.description: Whether QA review is required before this output is used downstream.

deadline.description: Hard deadline for task completion. Null = no deadline.

max_tokens.description: Maximum LLM tokens for this task.

issued_at.description: Timestamp when this task contract was issued.
